'''Ferlu-Da''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] commando living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He recruited off-worlder volunteers to help the commandos reclaim territory from the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] hostile to the Voss.
